product_lines.label: Custom cosmetic packaging
product_lines.cn: 高端定制彩盒 / 美妆包装
questions: How should a skincare brand compare custom cosmetic packaging suppliers?
What should be included in a cosmetic packaging RFQ brief?
product_lines.answer: Compare structure fit, insert or tray needs, print and finish direction, protection requirement, retail or ecommerce channel, artwork readiness and project review questions before asking suppliers for a quote.

product_lines.label: Rigid gift boxes
questions: What should buyers confirm before sampling rigid gift boxes?
How do inserts and finishes affect rigid gift box sourcing?
product_lines.answer: Confirm product size, product weight, lid and base or magnetic closure direction, insert structure, print coverage, finish reference and retail presentation before sampling.

product_lines.label: Corrugated mailer boxes
product_lines.cn: 食品 / 电商瓦楞飞机盒
questions: How should ecommerce brands choose corrugated mailer boxes?
What information should be sent for a custom corrugated box quote?
product_lines.answer: Start with product size, shipping route, protection level, board direction, print coverage and fulfillment method, then review whether the mailer structure fits both delivery and unboxing.

product_lines.label: Printed paper bags and eco paper packaging
questions: How should retail brands compare printed paper bag suppliers?
What paper bag details are needed before requesting a quote?
product_lines.answer: Compare bag size, paper direction, handle option, print coverage, finish reference, retail use case and packing method. Avoid treating sustainability wording as a generic claim without project-specific material confirmation.

product_lines.label: Paper tube packaging
questions: What should buyers compare when sourcing custom paper tube packaging?
How do diameter, cap and finish affect paper tube packaging quotes?
product_lines.answer: Compare diameter, height, cap style, inner fit, product weight, print coverage, finish reference and retail display goal before asking for sampling or quote review.
